perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance

perks.name: Subsistence

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Bottomless Grief
perks.desc: Increases magazine size. While you are the last living member of your fireteam, each final blow refills your magazine.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.desc: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Indomitability
perks.desc: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 102 from 23 April 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5kuhrmYKBDwvLtzZJQmxiK?si=7f73118bec6743ac) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. This is the fourth iteration of Hung Jury SR4 (Shiny), and it's as much of a stat monster as ever. Being a precision frame, you don't really need to worry about recoil direction, and as a scout rifle you don't need to think about range either - use the barrel and mag perks to boost handling or stability, and maybe a little reload speed instead. The BRAVE Hung Jury offers Kinetic Tremors in the first trait perk column, which you can pair with another damage perk in the second - Explosive Payload just works all the time, or One For All is +35% damage when procced. The Indomitability origin trait seems built for the Prismatic subclass, generating grenade of melle energy according to your subclass type. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "If you liked Explosive Payload and missed it on S14 and S19 you can grab that, or One for All that was only on S14’s perk pool. Kinetic Tremors also moved to column 3 allowing you to stack two damage perks! Rewind Rounds might be better if you're using Hung Jury as your primary and taking down wave after wave of enemies, pair that with Firefly for AoE damage and you will seldom reload. If you liked some of the older perks like Adrenaline Junkie you'll be better off keeping your older version." Recommended MW: Stability

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Speaking of the crucible the curated roll is almost perfect, if you don't like Enlightened Action you could instead opt for No Distractions or Rapid Hit. Both make subsequent shots easier to hit so you can achieve that blistering fast TtK. If you don't like the “gimmick” of Box Breathing you could try and farm our rolls with Explosive Payload or Cascade Point. The former adding extra flinch, the latter dropping the TtK to 0.60s but still requiring 3 crits and 1 body shot." Recommended MW: Stability or Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Precision(180) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "Hung Jury SR4 makes its fourth return. While I never got behind this weapon I am upset that Hung Jury SR4 has had three different versions in D2 and its original version in D1. Give me back the Black Armory weapons please and thank you. In terms of this new-new version of Hung Jury SR4 you will want Kinetic Tremors or Firefly for your AoE damage. Frenzy gives you some great damage coupled with any spec mod. Rapid Hit is a bit overkill for reload but gives decent stability. Arrowhead Brake brings up the recoil direction to 100 for an easy shooting experience."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability. Precision(180) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "In PvP Hung jury SR4 has one niche and that is with Box Breathing. Three-taps with Box Breathing and Rapid Hit will be a super easy shooting experience. You might lane with this gun more than others but it will give you a blistering fast TtK. Think Not Forgotten and Luna’s Howl time to kill."

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Does that make this version the best version yet? Kinda not really. All the base stats are the same The new Hung Jury now has the origin traits. It lost bottomless grief, one for all and adrenaline junkie. All fantastic perks depending on what you like to use. In their place we received no distractions, and frenzy. Frenzy is a fantastic addition and I love seeing it on more weapons, but losing things to not have as strong of a weapon next time around is a let down." Recommended MW - Reload.

First choice PvP roll for duelling. Inspired by DMB Podcast 275 conversation with @DefyFly. The main draw for Hung Jury as at v6.2.0.6 is Box Breathing in the second trait column, which means you can three tap any resilience (2 Crit + 1 Body of a 0.67s TTK) and two tap tap lower resiliences, as at Season 18 v6.2.0.6. To proc it though, you need to almost treat the weapon like it needs pre-charging by ADS-ing before an ancounter, It goes without saying, you need to land crits and stay mobile. You don't need extra range, so focus on Handling and Stability with your barrel and mag. Rapid Hit in the first trait column helps further with Stability (as well as a Reload Speed boost) Recommended MW: Handling, with a Full Auto Retrofit mod, Radar Tuner (to help you stay aware of your surroundings if hardscoping), Quick Access Sling or Sprint Grip mod depending on your preference.
